_doc: P4.PAGES.1 — Audit of candidate programmatic SEO pages. Doctrine: NO thin pages. Each candidate evaluated against existing coverage + underlying data density. Only ship if real content can stand on its own.
scope_quote: Create only when data density supports: tonight, this week, venue pages, show pages, comedian pages. Exit: No thin SEO pages.

candidates.recommended_action: DEFER — propose a 301 alias at the host level (Cloudflare rule) once GTM tagging confirms tonight-specific organic interest. Do not create a duplicate HTML page.
blockers: would shadow /shows.html canonical without adding new content
no host-level redirect mechanism wired yet

candidates.data_density: THIN — same listings as /shows.html with a 7-day range filter
candidates.recommended_action: DEFER — implement as /shows.html?range=7 query parameter on the existing page (no new file). If/when standalone landing-page demand surfaces, scaffold a small HTML that JS-redirects to /shows.html?range=7. Not built now: zero new content over directory page.
blockers: would be a thin SEO clone of /shows.html
no unique copy or curation justifies separate page

candidates.data_density: MIXED — 32 venues total, 14 have address='TBD' (per data/venues.json). Only ~18 venues have full address + neighborhood + metro and could support a non-thin per-venue page.
candidates.recommended_action: DEFER — wait for P1.DATA fill of TBD venue addresses + lineup history before scaffolding. Per-venue pages without address/metro/lineup are textbook thin SEO and would degrade the directory.
blockers: no per-venue lineup history yet (cannot anchor recurrence text)

candidates.data_density: ENOUGH for 13 verified_24h slugs in data/freshness-audit.json. Each has: name, venue, address, recurring day/time, language, 1–2 sentence editorial description, live ticket URL, freshness/confidence signal. Far above thin-page threshold.
candidates.recommended_action: BUILD — generate static page per verified_24h slug. Skip theatre-bo-julie (needs_human_review). Skip slugs whose target file already exists (preserve existing HTML).
candidates.sitemap_action: Added /shows/{slug}.html entries to sitemap.xml; kept /show.html?slug={slug} entries (legacy variant remains valid). New pages each declare <link rel="alternate" href="/show.html?slug={slug}"> to disambiguate.

candidates.already_covered_by: 227 existing static comedian profile pages under /c/
candidates.recommended_action: NO-OP — already exists, no new pages needed under this audit.
